description: Get a one-time link a person opens to claim the sandbox this server's key belongs to, so the account outlives its 24 hours and keeps its secrets. Give the link only to the person who should keep it. It works once, for 30 minutes or until the sandbox ends if that is sooner, and calling this again voids the earlier link. The sandbox key itself still ends on schedule: a claimed account goes on with a Developer key created for it. Not metered. On a key that is not an unclaimed sandbox it says so and claims nothing.
name: claim_sandbox

claimUrl.description: The one-time link for the person who should keep the sandbox.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working if nobody has used it.

title: Get a link that keeps this sandbox
